item_short_desc: Keep your maps and important documents safe and dry with the Rothco Map and Document Case. Designed for all weather conditions, this case features a weather-resistant exterior and clear lining, ensuring your documents remain visible and protected. The case includes 2 zip-lock storage bags, providing double protection against moisture and dirt. Additionally, the drainage grommets help to remove any accumulated water, ensuring your contents stay dry.
